games.title: Grammar Maze
games.description: A torch-lit 3D maze for the classroom. Every fork is an English question: choose the sign with the right answer and the class walks that way. Four zones lead to the gold, with timers, monsters, and topics for grades 10–12.

games.title: Mila Quest
games.description: A 3D running game for English vocabulary: 8 worlds, 56 stages, bosses, and difficulty settings.
